action_frame.blue_transform: square -> 99 - square, applied to source and destination

boundaries.A_model_forward: model forward only; tokens already resident on the device in the target dtype, contiguous; timed region is model(tokens) plus device synchronisation
boundaries.B_observation_tokenization_model: host NumPy observation (B,127,10,10) -> observation_batch_from_numpy (copy + contract validation) -> observation_to_tokens relayout -> host-to-device transfer -> model forward; timed region ends after device synchronisation
boundaries.C_observation_tokenization_model_selecti: boundary B, plus the normalized dense legality mask host-to-device transfer, masked greedy selection over the normalized action frame on device, readback of the chosen normalized identifiers, and conversion to absolute engine actions via stratego.model.action_frame

benchmark_method.dtype_convention: parameters and activations are both cast to the row's precision; the accepted loss functions upcast to float32 internally, identically for every candidate
benchmark_method.extended_probe_policy: batches above 2048 are attempted only while throughput is still improving by at least 2% and Metal memory remains below the pressure fraction
benchmark_method.float16_training_policy: pure float16: no autocast, no loss scaling, no optimizer, no parameter update; non-finite behaviour is reported rather than repaired

memory_guard.policy: a configuration is not attempted while Metal driver allocation is already above the pressure fraction, and extended batches stop at the same line; the host is never deliberately driven into OOM or swap

benchmark_method.synchronization: torch.mps.synchronize() immediately before and immediately after every timed region, and between training-step stages

target_generation.belief: stratego.training.belief_targets.dense_belief_target on the real GameState for the acting player: unresolved hidden opponent pieces only, in normalized squares, with BELIEF_IGNORE_INDEX elsewhere. Privileged, and used only as a backward-pass target -- never a model input
target_generation.policy: one action drawn per position from that position's own normalized legal list with a seeded generator; legality is then proved independently against both the normalized list and the normalized dense mask by verify_policy_targets_legal()
target_generation.value: a seeded uniform draw over the three WIN/DRAW/LOSS classes; the value target carries no game outcome and exists only to make the value head's backward pass real
